description: This Java source file defines the EncounterEditor class responsible for serializing and deserializing Encounter objects within the OpenMRS application. It provides methods to retrieve Encounter objects by ID and UUID, facilitating integration with HTML forms and other data exchange mechanisms.

classes.name: EncounterEditor
classes.description: A property editor class for serializing and deserializing Encounter objects, supporting retrieval by ID and UUID, used for data binding within the OpenMRS framework.

methods.name: getObjectById
methods.description: Retrieves an Encounter object by its integer ID via the EncounterService.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an Encounter object by its UUID via the EncounterService.
